slice: RPP-5dr pre-reconciled BLOCK/ENDBLK capture and callback cleanup

scope.facet: Separate DRW_DxfBlockSourceHandler, latched per BLOCK; no established DRW_Interface vtable slot or model layout change
scope.selection: Actual known-modern generation-1 CLI import; ordinary/legacy/unknown-header opt-out adds no raw BLOCK capture or source charging
scope.begin: Original parsed BLOCK before absent-name clearing or BLOCK_RECORD name/units/preview reconciliation; complete raw scalar body excluding code 0
scope.effective: Independently owned actual addBlock callback view, allowing those three reconciliation fields to differ; not yet proof that differences match a proven BLOCK_RECORD
scope.end: Distinct ENDBLK model/raw body after accepted footer boundary, immediately before addBlockEnd and before staged child replay
scope.ordering: beginSource, addBlock, endSource, addBlockEnd, staged child callbacks, endBlock; dropped blocks emit neither source endpoint
scope.partialPublication: Begin can precede malformed footer/input or throwing callback. Prefixes must not be used without successful whole import, valid context and retained consumer; no atomic callback transaction is claimed.
scope.state: Original entity cursor presence/mask observed before copying; sanitized copies do not qualify incomplete XDATA
scope.pairing: Common entity plus POINT/BLOCK retained values and original cursor agree with callback models, except the explicitly permitted effective reconciliation fields
scope.sourceOwnership: Distinct shared_ptr<const DRW_Block> original/effective/footer plus two owned raw carriers; no forged ATTDEF/TableEntry model cast
scope.quotas: Independent record/group/byte/work caps; precharged scalar inspection and logical snapshot/raw/control-node/copy-temporary allowances; native writer-binding sidecars refused before copying
scope.quotaLimits: Conservative logical allowances, not capacity/RSS, every process allocation or a strict CPU theorem; failed charged prefixes may remain and cannot be repaired in place
scope.generation: Appending a destination or late/out-of-context callbacks cannot refresh old block source evidence
scope.callbackScopeFix: Mark public scope entered before invoking addBlock inside its guard, so a partially established throwing begin gets one cleanup attempt without replacing the original exception
scope.drawings: All new controls are runtime-authored scratch DXF

owningControlsPerConfiguration.axes: Four modern versions x ASCII/Binary x with/without BLOCK_RECORD reconciliation x zero/one/two ATTDEF children
owningControlsPerConfiguration.observer: Separate original-file ASCII/Binary walker plus authored per-record ledger checks code/value byte bounds and complete begin/footer scalar inventories; no production parser reuse or normalized re-export
owningControlsPerConfiguration.observerLimit: Physical scalar inventory, not complete independent handle-role, child topology or external CAD semantic proof
owningControlsPerConfiguration.exceptionCoverage: Source begin, source end, typed footer, child, cleanup and typed begin, in both encodings, with/without secondary cleanup exception
owningControlsPerConfiguration.contextCoverage: Dropped/empty/absent-name, original default versus BLOCK_RECORD effective name, pending original XDATA versus sanitized copy, tolerated owner mismatch and legacy opt-out
owningControlsPerConfiguration.contextLimit: Pending XDATA and wrong owner may be retained as transport facts, never qualified by pairing/closure alone
owningControlsPerConfiguration.readerQuotaCoverage: Logical retained bytes and typed variant nodes, source on/off, both encodings; opt-out minimum is lower; same-codec recovery
owningControlsPerConfiguration.rawAllocationInterval: From source selection through raw capture, staging, public callbacks and read completion on one authored block per encoding
owningControlsPerConfiguration.allocationLimit: Calibrated observed C++ allocations only; raw schedules include terminal no-failure controls and any accepted complete cases, not 242 necessarily failing allocations or all process allocations
owningControlsPerConfiguration.immutableOwners: Mutable raw callback aliases and editable block/footer changes cannot alter frozen original/effective/footer models or source carriers
owningControlsPerConfiguration.recoveryDistinction: Adapter snapshot/callback routes use fresh data/session on the same adapter; raw-reader quota/allocation routes additionally verify reuse of the same dxfRW facade

typedBegin.before: Throwing addBlock after establishing consumer state left phase=6 depth=1 ends=0
typedBegin.after: All source/typed/footer/child/cleanup exception routes balance once and preserve the original exception; corrected imports recover

standaloneProbe.cause: Standalone raw-reader budget probe reused CLI addHeader/endBlock behavior with no destination; ASan identified the null-destination header callback
standaloneProbe.resolution: Standalone test receiver supplies appropriate header/cleanup behavior, while fileImport-backed cases retain the real CLI callbacks
